description: Source code for eswifi socket management, including socket creation, binding, starting/stopping clients, listening, accepting connections, and data reading, specifically for Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_type_from_zephyr
methods.description: Maps protocol number to eswifi transport type.

methods.name: __stop_socket
methods.description: Stops a socket, setting its state to none.

methods.name: __read_data
methods.description: Configures and reads data from the socket.

methods.name: __eswifi_bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to an address and port, supports UDP start.

methods.name: eswifi_off_read_work
methods.description: Handles asynchronous socket data reading and callback invocation.

methods.name: __eswifi_off_start_client
methods.description: Starts a client connection to a remote address.

methods.name: __eswifi_listen
methods.description: Configures socket to listen with specified backlog.

methods.name: __eswifi_accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming TCP connection, starts server.

methods.name: __eswifi_socket_free
methods.description: Frees socket resources and cancels ongoing work.

methods.name: __eswifi_socket_new
methods.description: Creates a new socket with specified family, type, protocol, and context.
